maria: late-night question — what's one song that instantly makes doing dishes feel like a ritual instead of a chore? :wave:
jordan: Arthur Russell — 'This Is How We Walk on the Moon' for slow suds. dreamy and oddly motivating :sparkles:
sam: OutKast — 'Prototype' for me. low-key groove, makes me sway while I dry plates. :sunglasses:
lee: instrumental rec: Nils Frahm — 'Says' — builds and hangs in the air, perfect for focused rinse-and-stack.
dana: also throwing a tiny book pairing: Nils Frahm + Haruki Murakami (Wind-Up Bird vibes) = surreal kitchen zen. :books:
maria: love that. I made a tiny playlist "dishes at midnight" with everyone's picks: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2A_fake_link :thumbsup:
spotify-bot: Added Jordan's pick and Sam's pick to the playlist.

sam: 1️⃣ :thumbsup:
